result.topic_en: Euler explains that no formula or rule generating new primes is known, and that finding primes beyond the existing tables (about 100000, or a recent table to 101000) would require sieving out composites by trial division by primes below the square root, which amounts to extending the prime table itself.

items.english: Anyone even slightly versed in such investigations will easily recognize that such a rule is a matter of the deepest inquiry, so that from here no hope at all shines of ever reaching a solution of the stated Fermatian problem.
